background_story: Dr. Yara Hernandez was a renowned astrophysicist who spent her career studying the mysteries of the universe. Her area of expertise was the study of celestial bodies, particularly those with unique shapes. Yara became fascinated with prolate spheroids, which are three-dimensional shapes that are elongated at the poles and flattened at the equator. She spent years researching and observing the behavior of prolate-shaped asteroids and comets, making groundbreaking discoveries that shed new light on the formation of our solar system. Yara's work took her to some of the world's most advanced telescopes, where she collaborated with colleagues to unravel the secrets of these enigmatic objects. Her tireless dedication to her craft earned her the prestigious Astronomer of the Year award, solidifying her reputation as a leading expert in her field.
